summary_en: The company will cancel 1,591,998 treasury shares on December 14, 2026, representing 6.7% of issued shares before cancellation. The cancellation is conditional upon shareholder approval of a stock split effective December 15, 2026, and will reduce issued shares to 22,298,802.
title_en: Notice Regarding Cancellation of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: Digital Hearts Holdings resolved at a board meeting held on October 23, 2026, to cancel 1,591,998 treasury shares in accordance with Article 178 of the Companies Act. The shares to be cancelled represent 6.7% of issued shares as of the cancellation decision date. The cancellation is scheduled for December 14, 2026, and is conditional upon shareholder approval of a stock split with an effective date of December 15, 2026. Upon completion of the cancellation, the company's issued share count will decrease to 22,298,802 shares.
